warmup.label: Warm-up superpower
warmup.spokenText: Warm-up time! Show me your Twinkle superpower. You already know this one!

concert.label: Concert
concert.spokenText: Concert time! Everyone is in their seats. Play your song for the whole audience!

comeback.label: Just one note
comeback.spokenText: Can you help me with just one note? Just one. Ready?
